item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a sustained policy that reduced domestic fear without replacing it with state terror.\nThe available positive material is limited to discretionary clemency and narrow procedural cooperation, not systemic protection from intimidation or abuse.\nI found no credible evidence of independent, rights-protective policing or a genuine de-escalation of the political fear climate.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Authorities used surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes to enforce veiling rules. This is strong evidence of a political fear climate built through routine coercion, not a reduction in insecurity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.5","3B.2"]},{"title":"Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed war on drugs","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/","summary":"Amnesty reported a major execution surge, including mass use of the death penalty after unfair Revolutionary Court trials. That supports a broader climate of fear, not protection from violence or insecurity.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Iran security forces rape, torture detainees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees","summary":"HRW documented rape, torture, sexual assault, and coerced false confessions by security forces. This is direct evidence that coercive state violence was used in ways that would intensify fear rather than reduce it.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.1","3B.2","3B.4"]},{"title":"Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty said there were still no effective, impartial investigations into killings, torture, sexual violence, or disappearances, while families faced harassment and arbitrary detention.
